summary: SDI intermediaries (Openapi.it / A-Cube) tested end-to-end. Backend: 14 public-URL tests (config CRUD, secret never leaked in /company/sdi, /company, /companies, RBAC 403 for contabile/operatore on PUT/test, field errors, real sandbox 401 -> readable Italian 400 on test/send/sdi-sync with invoice staying bozza, simulato regression send/refresh/sdi-sync) + 8 in-process mocked-provider tests (send stores sdi_provider/sdi_id/sdi_ambiente, RC->consegnata, NS->scartata + resend gets new id and resets sdi_seen, MC->mancata_consegna, 'Nessuna nuova notifica' on already-seen, received XML imported with origine 'sdi' and duplicates skipped, _sdi_sync_company background poll updates status + last_sync_at, refresh after switching provider -> 400). All 22 pass. Frontend: SdiCard (provider/ambiente selects, token/email/password inputs, hint, status badge, save/test buttons, field errors, masked placeholder after save, confirm dialog for Ambiente reale - dismissing keeps prova), Passive page sim-note vs sdi-note, 'Scarica da SDI' error toast with fake creds, Origine column 'SDI' vs 'SDI (demo)' - all working.

minor.issue: Only first page fetched (openapi page=1, acube itemsPerPage=50) and every XML on that page is re-downloaded on each 15-min sync before hash dedup; older invoices beyond page 1 never imported, wasted calls. Consider date filter / tracking last received uuid.
Manual refresh and background loop read sdi_seen from a stale snapshot; concurrent runs can push the same notification twice into sdi_history (no atomic $addToSet guard).
The companies.find() inside the while loop is not in try/except: a transient Mongo error kills the background task permanently until restart.

Token cache keyed by (email, ambiente) only: after the admin changes the A-Cube password, the old cached JWT keeps being used (up to 23h), so 'Prova collegamento' can report success with a wrong new password.

Not a code bug.
Optional hardening: paginate/limit received(), atomic dedup of notifications, try/except around _sdi_loop body, invalidate A-Cube token cache on password change.

A-Cube login uses common.api.acubeapi.com/login with body environment='sandbox' - matches A-Cube docs (alternative common-sandbox host).
Real provider send path skips local _sdi_checks (relies on provider validation) - acceptable but users get provider errors instead of the friendlier local ones.
